manifest_rules.min_engine_version_pattern: [1, minor, patch] for v1/v2 or '1.minor.patch' for v3 (major MUST be 1)

forbidden_path_patterns.reason: Raw Java Edition assets/ directory is never read by Bedrock Edition and bloats/corrupts the archive.
forbidden_path_patterns.actionable_fix: Map Java assets to their Bedrock equivalents (textures/, sounds/, texts/) or skip unsupported Java-only files.

forbidden_path_patterns.reason: Java pack.mcmeta is ignored by Bedrock Edition; Bedrock requires manifest.json.
forbidden_path_patterns.actionable_fix: Emit manifest.json instead of copying pack.mcmeta.

forbidden_path_patterns.reason: Operating system metadata/junk files should never be packaged into Bedrock resource packs.
forbidden_path_patterns.actionable_fix: Filter OS metadata files during archive/directory scanning.

forbidden_path_patterns.reason: Bedrock Edition does not read textures/mob_effect/; status effect icons live at textures/ui/<id>_effect.png.
Pure Bedrock Resource Packs CANNOT override vanilla 3D block geometry via models/entity/block/*.geo.json.
forbidden_path_patterns.actionable_fix: Extract the primary block texture into textures/blocks/ + terrain_texture.json and emit a structured warning; use a Behavior Pack custom block or item attachable for 3D geometry.

forbidden_path_patterns.reason: Raw Java LabPBR normal (_n.png) / specular (_s.png) textures are ignored by Bedrock without a *.texture_set.json and bloat pack size.
forbidden_path_patterns.actionable_fix: Enable PBR conversion to generate *_mer.png + *.texture_set.json, or omit LabPBR maps when PBR conversion is disabled.

non_empty_stub_rules: Do not emit textures/terrain_texture.json if texture_data is empty.
Do not emit textures/item_texture.json if texture_data is empty.
Do not emit texts/languages.json if no texts/*.lang files exist.
Every texture path referenced in terrain_texture.json, item_texture.json, flipbook_textures.json, *.texture_set.json, and attachables/*.json must exist inside the archive.
